reviews.title: Works!
reviews.comment: Working great in my Dell Latitude 7200 2 in 1 tablet!  I used Acronis True Image software to clone my old drive as it works best! a good value upgrade for my primary device!

reviews.title: customer support issues.
reviews.comment: i had an issue getting the computer to see the drive. contacted the seller and company tech support several days ago but have heard nothing back from either.  So looks like support is not good. i found the problem in the bios and got it going - no thanks to them.

reviews.title: Rock solid
reviews.comment: Plugged it into an older Surface Pro 7 plus with a failing drive. Fresh Win 11 install and updates and it's running like a dream. Zero problems.
